# Remove contaminant genes from transcriptional timecourse data 



## Load supplementary data 

Top 50 differentially expressed marker genes within each ‘cell of origin’ mouse cluster. Differential gene expression from Seurat’s likelihood ratio test (LRT) (two-sided) method was used to generate the marker genes for all of mouse developing time points (n=34 clusters) (Figure-1 and Extended Figure-1) (tab 1) and curated and filtered mouse developing time points used for the generation of CIBERSORT deconvolution signatures (n=31 clusters) (Extended Figure-2) (tab 2). The top 50 genes were selected based on the log2 fold change.

https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-019-1158-7#Sec25
https://static-content.springer.com/esm/art%3A10.1038%2Fs41586-019-1158-7/MediaObjects/41586_2019_1158_MOESM4_ESM.xlsx


```{r load_data}

library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)


MTscRNAseq <- read_xlsx("~/Dropbox/GNP_MB_integrate/MT_scRNAseq/41586_2019_1158_MOESM4_ESM.xlsx", sheet = 1)
MTscRNAseq_2 <- read_xlsx("~/Dropbox/GNP_MB_integrate/MT_scRNAseq/41586_2019_1158_MOESM4_ESM.xlsx", sheet = 2)

MTscRNAseq <- as_tibble(MTscRNAseq)

relabeler <- MTscRNAseq %>% 
              drop_na(Annotations) %>%
              dplyr::select(cluster, Annotations)

colnames(MTscRNAseq)[1] <- "gene_names"

MTscRNAseq <- MTscRNAseq %>%
  left_join(., relabeler, by = "cluster") %>%
  dplyr::select(!Annotations.x) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Annotations = Annotations.y )

```



```{r}
dim(MTscRNAseq)
table(MTscRNAseq$Annotations)

 MTscRNAseq %>%
   dplyr::filter(Annotations == "Purkinje cells") %>% 
   dplyr::select(gene)


```


```{r,  fig.height= 5, fig.width= 5}
MTscRNAseq %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = pct.1, 
           y = pct.2, 
           colour = avg_logFC)) + 
  geom_point( alpha = 0.5, size = 0.5) + 
  facet_wrap(~Annotations) 
  

```



```{r, fig.height= 5, fig.width= 5}
MTscRNAseq %>%
   dplyr::filter(avg_logFC > 2) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = pct.1, 
           y = pct.2, 
           colour = Annotations,  label = gene_names)) + 
  geom_point( alpha = 1, size = 2) + 
    geom_text_repel() 




```


```{r, fig.height= 5, fig.width= 8}
MTscRNAseq %>%
  dplyr::filter(avg_logFC > 1.5) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = avg_logFC, 
           y = Annotations, 
           colour = Annotations,  label = gene_names)) + 
  geom_jitter( alpha = 1, size = 2) + 
    geom_text_repel() 




```


Determine the number of genes excluded by logFC cutoff 

```{r}
gn_lineage_names <- names(table(MTscRNAseq$Annotations))[stri_detect_fixed(names(table(MTscRNAseq$Annotations)), "GCP") | stri_detect_fixed(names(table(MTscRNAseq$Annotations)), "Granule", case_insensitive=TRUE)]




  MTscRNAseq <- MTscRNAseq %>%
    # split by GNP and not GNP lineages 
    mutate(gn_lineage =  case_when(
      Annotations %in% gn_lineage_names  ~ "Granule_neuron_lineage",
     TRUE  ~ "other"
    )
)

```

```{r}
MTscRNAseq %>%
    dplyr::filter(avg_logFC > 1) %>%
    dplyr::filter(p_val < 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(gn_lineage,Annotations) %>%
    dplyr::summarize(gene_num = length( gene_names)) 

```

## Import raw data from GEO 

```{r}
library(Matrix)
matrix_dir = "~/Dropbox/GNP_MB_integrate/MT_scRNAseq/GSE118068_RAW/"
first_file = "~/Dropbox/GNP_MB_integrate/MT_scRNAseq/GSE118068_RAW/GSM3317999_E10_"
scfiles <- list.files(path = "~/Dropbox/GNP_MB_integrate/MT_scRNAseq/GSE118068_RAW/")

```

Setup to move the files
```{r}
all.new <- gsub("GSM\\d+", "/",scfiles)
all.new <- gsub("_", "/",all.new)
all.new <- gsub("//", "/",all.new)
all.dirs <- gsub("genes.tsv.gz", "", all.new[grep("genes.tsv.gz",  all.new)])
all.dirs <- substr(all.dirs,1,nchar(all.dirs)-1)
all.dirs <- paste0(gsub("_RAW/", "", matrix_dir), all.dirs)

all.new <- paste0(gsub("_RAW/", "", matrix_dir), all.new)
all.path <- paste0( matrix_dir, scfiles)
```

Move files individual directories 

```{r, eval = FALSE}

# copy the files to the new folder
sapply(all.dirs, function(x) dir.create(x,  recursive = TRUE))
file.copy(all.path, all.new, overwrite = TRUE, copy.mode = TRUE )
```


Read the entire data set, takes about 5 min 
```{r}


barcode.path <- paste0(matrix_dir, scfiles[grep("barcodes", scfiles)])
matrix.path <- paste0(matrix_dir, scfiles[grep("matrix", scfiles)])
genes.path <- paste0(matrix_dir, scfiles[grep("genes", scfiles)])

prefix_names <- gsub( "matrix.mtx.gz", "", matrix.path)
sc_sample_names <- str_split(prefix_names, "_")
sc_sample_names <- unname(as.vector(as.data.frame(sc_sample_names, col.names = seq(1:length(sc_sample_names)))[6,]))
names(all.dirs) <- sc_sample_names

sce <- read10xCounts(all.dirs,  compressed = TRUE)
dim(assay(sce))
colnames(colData(sce))
colnames(rowData(sce))
```

```{r}
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
```

Add the cell types to the colData 

```{r}
clust2name <- as_tibble(as.data.frame(table(MTscRNAseq$cluster, MTscRNAseq$Annotations)))
clust2name <- clust2name %>% 
  dplyr::filter(Freq != 0) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Var1) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(cluster = as.numeric(Var1), name = as.character(Var2)) %>%
  dplyr::select(cluster, name) 


sce_colData3 <- dplyr::left_join(sce_colData2, clust2name, by = c("cluster" = "cluster"))

```

Re-enter the revised colData

Plot GNP transcript against the max of other other lineages 

To do this we take the cluster groups from the original paper and average the transcripts per cell type.  Then we divide into the granule neuron lineage and non granule neuron lineage and the maximum expression for a given gene is determined in those 2 groups.   

```{r}
sce_agg <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce, ids = sce$cluster, statistics = "mean", use.assay.type = "logcounts")
sce_agg_df <- data.frame(logcounts(sce_agg))
sce_agg_df$ensbl_names <- row.names(sce_agg_df)
sce_agg_df <- as_tibble(sce_agg_df)


clust2name <- clust2name %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(gn_lineage =  name %in% gn_lineage_names)


sce_agg_df_flat <- sce_agg_df %>%
  tidyr::gather(cluster, value, -ensbl_names ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(cluster = as.numeric(gsub("X", "", cluster)))  %>% 
  dplyr::left_join(., clust2name,  by = c("cluster" = "cluster"))

  
sce_agg_df_wide <- sce_agg_df_flat %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(ensbl_names, gn_lineage) %>%
  dplyr::slice(which.max(value)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(cluster > 0) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(ensbl_names) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(gn_cluster = cluster[gn_lineage], 
                   non_gn_cluster = cluster[!gn_lineage], 
                   gn_name = name[gn_lineage], 
                   non_gn_name = name[!gn_lineage],
                   gn_max_logn = value[gn_lineage],
                   non_gn_max_logn = value[!gn_lineage],
                   )
  

sce_agg_df_wide %>%
 ggplot(aes(x = gn_max_logn, y = non_gn_max_logn)) +
 geom_point(size = 0.2, alpha =0.5)
  



  

sce_agg_df_wide %>%
      dplyr::mutate(gn_max_logn_fc =non_gn_max_logn -gn_max_logn) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(gn_max_logn = Winsorize(gn_max_logn, minval = 0, maxval = 4 ) ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(gn_max_logn_fc = Winsorize(gn_max_logn_fc, minval = -0.5, maxval = 4 ) ) %>%
 ggplot(aes(x = gn_max_logn, y = gn_max_logn_fc )) +
 geom_point(size = 0.2, alpha =0.5)
  

```

Exlude genes based upon low expression and by expression in another tissue 

Make a categorical variable with 
1. Expressed in GN lineage
2. Significantly more expressed in other cell type 
3. Unexpressed in GN lineage 



```{r}
expr_cutoff <- 0.1
pval_cutoff <- 100

sce_agg_df_wide %>%

    theme_classic() + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  
  sce_agg_df_wide %>%

  dplyr::mutate(other_expr = ifelse(non_gn_max_logn > expr_cutoff, "other_expr", "other_unexpr"   )) %>%
```

# Cell cycle genes 

There are a lot of genes that are expressed in the bulk sample that are not expressed in the any cell in the scRNAseq.  Could they be related to cells undergoing mitosis. 

To start get a list of genes that are typically excluded from scRNAseq experiments as being associated with cell cycle.  The Taylor paper excluded these cells. 

We will use the data from this paper.
A high-resolution transcriptome map of cell cycle reveals novel connections between periodic genes and cancer
Daniel Dominguez, Yi-Hsuan Tsai, Nicholas Gomez, Deepak Kumar Jha, Ian Davis & Zefeng Wang 
Cell Research volume 26, pages946–962 (2016)

```{r}
cell_cycle_genes <- read_excel("~/Dropbox/GNP_MB_integrate/MT_scRNAseq/41422_2016_BFcr201684_MOESM26_ESM.xlsx", 
                               skip = 4)
dim(cell_cycle_genes)
table(cell_cycle_genes$Stage)
```


Generate human to mouse ensembl gene list 

```{r, eval = FALSE}


human = useMart("ensembl", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")
listAttributes(human)
possible_attrib <- listAttributes(human)
possible_attrib[grep( "hsapiens", possible_attrib$name),]

attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "ensembl_transcript_id", "mmusculus_homolog_ensembl_gene", "mmusculus_homolog_ensembl_peptide", "mmusculus_homolog_orthology_type", "mmusculus_homolog_canonical_transcript_protein", "mmusculus_homolog_perc_id")



listAttributes(mouse)
possible_attrib <- listAttributes(mouse)
possible_attrib[grep( "hsapien", possible_attrib$name),]

orth.mouse = getBM( attributes,values =TRUE, mart = human, bmHeader=FALSE)
dim(orth.mouse)

length(unique(orth.mouse$mmusculus_homolog_ensembl_gene))
orth.mouse.filt = getBM( attributes,values =TRUE, mart = human, bmHeader=FALSE, filters="with_mmusculus_homolog")
dim(orth.mouse.filt)
length(unique(orth.mouse.filt$mmusculus_homolog_ensembl_gene))
attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id","hgnc_symbol")
human_HGNC = getBM( attributes,values =TRUE, mart = human, bmHeader=FALSE) 

orth.mouse.filt <- merge(x = orth.mouse.filt, y= human_HGNC, by.x = 1, by.y  = 1, all.x = TRUE)
colnames(orth.mouse.filt)[1] <- "hg_ensembl_gene_id"


orth.mouse.filt.best <- orth.mouse.filt %>%
  dplyr::group_by(mmusculus_homolog_ensembl_gene) %>%
  dplyr::slice(which.max(mmusculus_homolog_perc_id))


write.table(orth.mouse.filt.best, file = "~/Dropbox/GNP_MB_integrate/Ezh2_2022/orth_mouse_filt_best.txt", sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE)
```

Generate the final categorical variable that describes excluded genes by being highly expressed in other cells, as well genes known to be related to cell cycle. 


2. Cell cycle related gene 
3. Expression in GN lineas
3. Expression in other cell type and no expression in granule neurons
4. Expression in other cell type passing a fold change cuttoff 
5. Hh signalling by GDC0449 RNAseq in GNPs 


We have to be careful because once the cells are differentiated the RNA can be in processes that are not maintained during the extraction of single cells.  Preserving this RNA is the major advantage to TRAP dataset generated by the Hatten lab.

```{r}
sce_agg_merged_cc_ann <-sce_agg_merged_cc %>%
  dplyr::mutate(exclude_cat = case_when(
     # `Core 67` == "YES"                         ~  "Cell_cycle_core",
      Stage %in% c("G1-S", "G2-M")               ~  "Cell_cycle",
 
    gn_exclude == "gn_expr seurat_other" &   (!(max_expr_Hatten >  500 | max_expr_Scott >  1000))    ~ "GN_expressed_other_lineage_more_seurat", 
    
      gn_exclude == "gn_unexpr seurat_other" &   (!(max_expr_Hatten >  500 | max_expr_Scott >  1000))    ~ "GN_not_expressed_other_lineage_expressed",
      gn_max_logn_fc > 2 ~ "GN_expressed_other_lineage_more_fc", 
     max_cat == "unexpressed" & gn_expr == "gn_unexpr" &  other_expr == "other_expr"   ~ "GN_unexpressed_other_lineage_expressed",
  max_cat == "unexpressed" & gn_expr == "gn_unexpr" &  other_expr == "other_unexpr" ~ "Unexpressed_cerebellar_lineages",
     # excludes genes that don't reach bulk RNAseq expression threshold
        max_cat == "unchanged" | cat_avg_fc == "0-1 log2FC"     ~ "GN_expressed_not_changing",
 #     P7_GNP_GDC0449_subset_2F == "P7_GNP_high" ~ "Shh related genes",
      
      # what should be included 
      
      
      TRUE                                ~  "other"

  ))

table(sce_agg_merged_cc_ann$gn_exclude, sce_agg_merged_cc_ann$gn_expr)
table(sce_agg_merged_cc_ann$exclude_cat)
table(sce_agg_merged_cc_ann$exclude_cat,sce_agg_merged_cc_ann$gn_exclude)
```

```{r}

sce_agg_merged_cc_ann <-sce_agg_merged_cc_ann %>%
  dplyr::mutate(group_1 = case_when(
     # `Core 67` == "YES"                         ~  "Cell_cycle_core",
      exclude_cat == "Cell_cycle"             ~  "Cell cycle",
      
      exclude_cat %in% c("GN_expressed_other_lineage_more_seurat", 
                         "GN_not_expressed_other_lineage_expressed",
                         "GN_expressed_other_lineage_more_fc")
                                      ~ "Contaminated genes", 
      
      exclude_cat %in% c("Unexpressed_cerebellar_lineages", 
                         "GN_unexpressed_other_lineage_expressed") 
                                    ~ "Unexpressed",
      
      exclude_cat == "GN_expressed_not_changing"
                                     ~ "Unchanged expression",
      
      exclude_cat == "other"       ~ "Dynically expressed in granule neuron lineage",
      
      TRUE                                ~  "other"

  )) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(group_2 = case_when(
      group_1 == "Cell cycle"             ~  "Cell cycle",
      
      group_1 == "Contaminated genes" &   
        exclude_cat %in% c("GN_expressed_other_lineage_more_seurat", 
                         "GN_expressed_other_lineage_more_fc")
                                      ~  "Granule neuron lineage expressed", 
      
      group_1 == "Contaminated genes" &   
        exclude_cat == "GN_not_expressed_other_lineage_expressed"
                                      ~  "Granule neuron lineage not expressed", 

      exclude_cat == "Unexpressed_cerebellar_lineages"
                                      ~ "Unexpressed", 
      exclude_cat == "GN_unexpressed_other_lineage_expressed"
                                    ~ "Unexpressed",
      
      exclude_cat == "GN_expressed_not_changing"
                                     ~ "Unchanged expression",
    
      group_1 == "Dynically expressed in granule neuron lineage" & 
                        cat_avg_fc == "1-2 log2FC" 
                                    ~ "1-2 log2FC",
      
      group_1 == "Dynically expressed in granule neuron lineage" & 
                        cat_avg_fc == ">2 log2FC" 
                                    ~ ">2 log2FC",
      
      TRUE                                ~  "other"

  ))
```

The scRNAseq time course ends at P14 so it is not suprising that there are many genes that are showing up as high in the Hatten data set 





```{r, fig.height= 8, fig.width= 8}
max_timecourse_plot <- sce_agg_merged_cc_ann %>%
  #dplyr::filter(!(max_cat %in% c("unchanged", "unexpressed"))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(t50_cat = factor(t50_cat, levels = c("Early", "Mid", "Late"))) %>%
  dplyr::filter(max_cat != "unexpressed", max_cat != "unchanged") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Winsorize(avg_t50, maxval = 30), 
           y = Winsorize(avg_fc, minval = -7.5, maxval = 7.5))) + 
  geom_point(aes(color=exclude_cat), 
             size = 1.25, alpha = 0.9, shape = 16) + 
  # circle the labeled points 
  geom_point(data = subset(sce_agg_merged_cc, mgi_symbol %in% label_genes ), 
                  aes(x = Winsorize(avg_t50, maxval = 30), 
                      y = Winsorize(avg_fc, minval = -7.5, maxval = 7.5)), 
           shape = 1,         # Hollow squares
               size = 4, alpha = 1) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) + 
  # add the text label 
  geom_text_repel(data = subset(sce_agg_merged_cc, mgi_symbol %in% label_genes ), 
                  aes(x = Winsorize(avg_t50, maxval = 30), 
                      y = Winsorize(avg_fc, minval = -7.5, maxval = 7.5), 
           label = mgi_symbol), 
           point.padding = 1,
           box.padding = 0.25,
           size = 7) + 
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0,2,4,6), 
                     expand = c(0, 0),
                     name = "log2 fold change") + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = time_points, 
                     labels = names(time_points), 
                     name = "Time at 50% max change (t50)", 
                     expand = c(0, 0)) + 
  scale_colour_discrete(name = "Category for time at 50% max change") + 
  facet_grid(group_1~max_cat) +
  #facet_wrap(~exclude_cat) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette="Set1")+
   scale_colour_brewer(palette="Set1")+
  #scale_color_manual(values = k2color[,1]) +
  ##scale_fill_manual(values = k2color[,1]) +
  #scale_shape_manual(values=1:nlevels(toc_t50$k_15_comp)) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position="bottom", 
        text = element_text(size = 18),
        strip.text.x = element_text(size = 20),
          panel.grid.major =element_blank(),
          #panel.grid.major.y =element_line(colour = "grey" ),
          panel.grid.minor=element_blank(),
          plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "white"), 
          strip.background = element_blank()) + 
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size=10)))
          #panel.border=element_blank())


max_timecourse_plot
```
